about_the_game:
Auto Legends is where real car culture meets competition, giving everyone—from newcomers to seasoned gearheads—a chance to build, race, and become legendary.

Pick your starter car and make it your own with real performance parts, precision tuning, and custom designs. Compete in high-stakes races for cash, pinks, or pure glory as you climb the ranks and prove your skill.

Legends aren’t born—they’re built. It’s time to start your journey.


Competitive Racing

  • Show off your ride and style in front of real spectators, or watch live races and support your friends.

  • Go head-to-head with matchmaking in multiple straight-line racing modes.

  • Race for cash, or wager your ride and put pink slips on the line.

     

Realistic Customization

  • Purchase engine parts, wheels, and body kits from real-world manufacturers.

  • Performance tune your car at speciality garages and get it ready for the next race.

  • Make it your own by adding cosmetic customizations and unique paint jobs.

  • Influence the rarity, demand, and value of your car by how you customize and care for it.

     

Social Communities

  • Earn fame through expert tuning, bold styling, and race-day dominance.

  • Rise to the top of leaderboards and collect achievements.

  • Become part of a team, or create your own crew, and capture tournament rewards.

  • Buy and sell cars and parts with community members.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 13+ (Ventura)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 Integrated
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 13+ (Ventura)
  • Processor: Apple M2

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Auto Legends is currently in Closed Beta - please note that your progress data may get reset throughout the development process
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX970 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Auto Legends is a high-stakes drag racing game where skill, strategy, and car culture collide. Build, tune, and customize your ride, then race for cash, pinks, and glory as you climb the ranks to become a legend.
